title: Place a visitor on hold
summary: Pause a visitor without losing their place — to hand them to a colleague with the right skills, or while they step out — and pick them up again from On Hold.
bodyMd:
Placing a visitor on hold moves them to the On Hold view without sending them back to the end of the queue. Use it to hand a visitor to a colleague with a different skill set (for example escalating to a manager), or when the visitor needs to step out briefly. The option must be turned on by an HQ Admin first.

Before you begin

  • A Retail Admin sign-in for your store — see Sign in to the Retail Admin site (no SAML/SSO), or use single sign-on if your organisation has Integrate single sign-on (SAML) for store staff.
  • Allow Staff to Place Visitor "On Hold" is on under Platform Admin → Queueing / Appointments → Queue Settings — see Queue settings reference.

Place a visitor on hold

  1. In the left navigation of Retail Admin, select QUEUEING & APPTS.
  2. Open the visitor you are serving.
  3. Select the on-hold option. A dialog opens.
  4. Either enter a note explaining what the visitor needs, for example Needs a manager, or choose a language from Languages Spoken.

    Only languages spoken by staff currently on shift are listed.

  5. Select Place Visitor On Hold.

Pick a visitor up from On Hold

  1. Select the On Hold view. Each card shows the note or language in square brackets next to the visitor's name.
  2. On the visitor's card, select Pick up, then continue as in Pick up a visitor from the queue.

Verify it worked

The visitor's card moves from In Progress to On Hold with the note or language shown, and your own status returns to Available.
